scenario: Exact arbitrary-precision decimal strings must preserve scales, reject binary floating point, and follow Laravel SalesLineCalculator RoundingMode::HALF_UP policy and TaxPercentage 0..100 (commit f8a0cf7012c4875bec7320d42e0f8dde58593b52)

test_cases.name: sales_line_calculator_exclusive_16_percent
test_cases.rounding_sequence: 1. raw subtotal 0.333 * 19.99 = 6.65667 rounded to 2 minor units = 6.66; 2. tax = 6.66 * (16 / 100) = 1.0656 rounded to 2 minor units = 1.07; 3. line total = 6.66 + 1.07 = 7.73, stored as 6-decimal scale

test_cases.name: sales_line_calculator_inclusive_16_percent
test_cases.rounding_sequence: 1. raw subtotal 6.65667 rounded to 2 minor units = 6.66; 2. net = 6.66 / 1.16 = 5.741379... rounded to 2 minor units = 5.74; 3. tax = 6.66 - 5.74 = 0.92; total = 6.66

test_cases.name: trailing_zero_quantity_support
test_cases.description: Verifies positive quantities with trailing zeros like 0.100000 are valid and accurately computed

test_cases.name: half_up_vs_half_even_parity
test_cases.description: Demonstrates critical divergence between unverified Banker's rounding (HALF_EVEN) and verified Laravel policy (HALF_UP)

test_cases.name: canonical_tax_example_ils_gross_50_incl_16
test_cases.description: ILS gross 50.000000 with 16% inclusive tax yields net 43.100000 and tax 6.900000 (sub - net), NOT floating/unrounded 6.896552

test_cases.name: max_magnitude_boundaries
